scope: Owned prose in the distributed Linux easy installer; external package-manager/polkit/Zenity standard buttons are provider text. Current source contains English-only titles, confirmations and diagnostics.

candidates.source: if ! [[ $major =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || ((major < 10)); then echo 'The current enterprise RPM requires RHEL 10 or a compatible version 10 derivative.' >&2; return 1; fi
if ! [[ $major =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || ((major < 44)); then echo 'The current Fedora package requires Fedora 44 or newer.' >&2; return 1; fi
*) echo 'This distribution has no reviewed package yet. See the GitHub releases for supported builds.' >&2; return 1 ;;
zenity --info --title='SoundCurrent installer' --text="$1"
kdialog --title 'SoundCurrent installer' --msgbox "$1"
zenity --question --title='Install or update SoundCurrent' --text="$1"
kdialog --title 'Install or update SoundCurrent' --yesno "$1"
[[ -t 0 ]] || { echo 'Run this installer interactively in a terminal.' >&2; return 1; }
printf '%s\nContinue? [y/N] ' "$1"; local answer; read -r answer
[[ $# -ge 2 && -f $2 ]] || { echo 'Provide an existing package after --package-file.' >&2; return 2; }
*) echo 'Unknown option.' >&2; return 2 ;;
echo "Usage: bash $0 [--dry-run|--download-only] [--package-file PATH]"; return;; *) echo 'Unknown option.' >&2; return 2;; esac
[[ $(uname -m) == x86_64 ]] || { echo 'These reviewed packages require an x86-64 computer.' >&2; return 1; }
[[ -r /etc/os-release ]] || { echo 'Cannot identify this distribution.' >&2; return 1; }
command -v "$manager" >/dev/null || { echo "This system is missing $manager." >&2; return 1; }
message "A newer $product ($installed) is already installed. It was kept; this Linux installer provides $version."; return 0
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null || { echo 'sha256sum is required.' >&2; return 1; }
message 'Use Quit to exit the running SoundCurrent app before updating. Closing its window keeps it running.'; return 1
confirm "Download and verify $product $version for ${PRETTY_NAME:-$ID}? No installation will be performed." || return 0

confirm "Install or update $product $version on ${PRETTY_NAME:-$ID}? Your presets and profiles are kept. The package manager installs dependencies and adds an app-menu icon. Administrator approval is needed. Only one equalizer should run at a time." || return 0
else echo 'Install curl or wget first.' >&2; return 1; fi
printf '%s  %s\n' "$expected" "$package" | sha256sum --check --status || { message 'Package verification failed. Nothing was installed.'; return 1; }
[[ ! -e $destination ]] || { echo "Already exists: $destination" >&2; return 1; }
cp -- "$package" "$destination"; message "Verified package saved to $destination"; return
message "This package needs glibc $required or newer; this system has $actual. Nothing was installed."; return 1
message "Installed $product $version. Open it from the applications menu. Use Quit and reopen after an update. No uninstall or reboot is needed for the app update."
